title: Observability and tracing
summary: Observability connects runtime signals so engineers can explain a system’s behavior and failures.
overview: Traces represent a request as related spans across operations and services. For an agent, instrument model calls, tool calls, and orchestration steps alongside service telemetry.
why: An end-to-end duration alone cannot identify which dependency or step caused a delay.
example: A support-agent trace shows retrieval taking 200 milliseconds and a billing API retry consuming most of the response time.
judgment: Decide which events and identifiers support diagnosis, and which sensitive payloads must be omitted.
next: Can we follow one failed task through its tool call into the downstream service?
